SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 79
Date............6. 3. 29

March 6, 9

Chief Clerk,
Provisional Court.

Sir,

With reference to the attached Provisional
Court despatch No. 1890 dated February 27, I have to
inform you that enquiries have been made, but the
alleyway named Bing Oen Li ( 平安里 ) referred to
therein cannot be located.

No. 270 Hankow Road is occupied by the "Tsang
Dah" silk store and this address is situated at the
corner of Hankow and Fokien Roads, not in an alleyway.

A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

page_data.en:
Translation of an order issued by Shanghai
Provisional Court dated February, 1929
------------

A letter has been received by this Court from Wu-tsing(武進)
Hsien Government. It reads as follows:
"Loh Hsuan Tai (陸宣大), residing in An Shiar Shiang
(安尚鄉), Wu-tsing Hsien, reported that ■■ Chang Sai Kung
(張善根), plotting together with his younger brother Chang
Kiu Tai (張九大), kidnapped and sold Loh Ai Siu, (陸愛秀),
step-daughter of Loh Hsuan Tai (陸宣大). The complainant,
the two accused and the victim were summonsed and appeared
before our court. The complainant stated that his step-daughter
Ai Siu (愛秀) had been sold by Chang Sai Kung (張善根) to a
man named Sung (沈), who keeps a brothel at No. 270 Ping An Lee
(平安里), Hankow Road, Shanghai. The victim, Loh Ai Siu (陸
愛秀) made her statement to the effect that Chang Kiu Tai (張
九大) sold her making a proceed of $270.00. Both the accused,
on being questioned, denied having made such a sale. Aparting
from giving orders at Court that necessary enquiries should be
made with a view to bringing out the real facts of the case, we
write to you to note with a request that you please instruct
police to make immediate enquiries at the address mentioned
above to ascertain whether Chang Sai Kung and Chang Kiu Tai
conspired together, abducted and sold Loh Ah Siu for money-
making or not. An early reply is requested".
You are therefore ordered to make discreet enquiries at
the given address and submit a report which will be sent to
Wu-tsing Hsien Government.
(Signed) Ho Shih-chen
President,
Shanghai Provisional Court
This order is issued to Dated February, 1929
the Judicial Police.
page_data.zh:
上海临时法院于1929年2月签发之命令译文
------------

本院收到武进县政府来函。内容如下：
“居住于武进县安尚乡的陆宣大报案称，■■ 张善根与其弟张九大合谋，绑架并出卖了陆宣大的继女陆爱秀。原告、两名被告及受害人已被传唤至我院出庭。原告陈述，其继女爱秀被张善根卖给了上海汉口路平安里270号开设妓院的沈姓男子。受害人陆爱秀供称，张九大将其卖出，得款270.00元。两名被告受审时均否认有此买卖行为。除在法庭上命令进行必要调查以查明案件真相外，特致函贵处，请指令警方立即前往上述地址调查，查明张善根与张九大是否合谋绑架并出卖陆爱秀以牟利。恳请早日复函。”
因此，命令你在指定地址进行秘密调查，并提交报告，以便转送武进县政府。
（签名）何世桢
院长，
上海临时法院
本命令签发予司法警察。 日期：1929年2月
